notes: I replaced the quadratic fit with a saturating Weibull-type curve `y = A*(1 - exp(-(x/tau)^p))` fitted to all 13 defined points, since the data clearly flattens toward ~1000 rather than growing quadratically (the quadratic badly overshot at x=123.6 and undershot at x=1.2). The undefined region `x < 0` is kept.
